lines.zh: 我高高地悬着，慢慢移动。
lines.en: I hang high and move slowly.
My discs turn in rings.
I drift above the treetops.

lines.zh: 我的身体很长，拖在后面。
lines.en: My long body trails behind.
I pass through a gap between end islands.
My plates shift out of line.
I hover right above my anchor.
I correct my course slowly.
The air parts around me.

lines.zh: 我的影子横过整片林子。
lines.en: My shadow crosses the whole forest.
I stop and hang in place.
I rise two more blocks.
I hover with a ring of discs turning.

lines.zh: 我的外壳安静得像块碑。
lines.en: My shell is still as a slab.

lines.zh: 我在磨最外圈的那张盘。
lines.en: I'm honing the outermost disc.
I count the trees below.
My eyes are three thin slits.

lines.zh: 我悬在高处，等你的吩咐。
lines.en: I hang high up, waiting for your word.
My gears mesh steadily.
I turn a full circle, slowly.
High up, I see clearly.
I draw my discs in a bit.

lines.zh: 我在听末地岛间的风声。
lines.en: I listen to the wind between the End islands.
Tree shadows play on my shell.
I drop a block and rise again.
I'm computing the next position.
You look up, and I'm overhead.
I'm well above your height.
All three of my discs face you.
If you'd speak, speak up.
I've looked over your armor.
I descend two blocks.
All of this is under my eyes.
Stone falls right beneath me. Move.
My shell carries old battle scars.
The island behind you is empty.

lines.zh: 我的三张盘一直朝下对着你。
lines.en: My three discs have been angled down at you all along.
What would you have me do?
I'm good for digging and for fighting.
I can carry things. Steadily.
Let's drift a while together.

lines.zh: 我降到三格高，等你说话。
lines.en: I drop to three blocks and wait for you to speak.
The outermost disc shattered.
I lose a block of altitude.
My shell has caved in.
My gears turn roughly.
I correct my attitude slowly.

lines.zh: 三道盘全歪了，我重校姿势。
lines.en: All three discs skew; I re-level myself.
I climb to a higher spot.
My discs turn slower now.
Your angles are truer than mine.
I need to withdraw for now.
I could cut that island root.
You set it on the island stone.

lines.zh: 我降到矿脉边上，探出盘。
lines.en: I drop beside the seam and extend a disc.
I know that ore.
I extend one disc.
Let me cut from this side.
One turn and the stone splits.
What you want is deep down.
One more cut.
I know this job well.
All I dig is yours.
Not so close; stone will fly.
You hit me and my armor rings.
I rise to let you pass.
My disc grazes your helmet.
Don't push; I'm high above ground.
We collide and I spin half around.
You touched the outer disc.

lines.zh: 我身上刻着叉号，是改过的型号。
lines.en: A cross is cut into me, a revised model.
That dropped me a block.
I hover just above you.
I drift away slowly.

lines.zh: 另一台从岛的边上飘来。
lines.en: Another drifts from the island's edge.
Our discs click against each other.

lines.zh: 我高高悬着，圆盘一圈圈转。
lines.en: I hang high, my discs turning in rings.
We hang in the air together.
It gives me its outer disc.
Our gears have synced.
Two cutting, the stone flies.
We drift shoulder to shoulder.

lines.zh: 它挡住了向我吹来的风。
lines.en: It blocks the wind blowing at me.
We take turns watching this place.
I pinch up a piece of ore.
I clamp it into my shell.
Enough here to grind a disc.

lines.zh: 我用盘夹起一块矿石，抛了一下接住。
lines.en: My disc picks up ore; I toss it once and catch it.
Too heavy; I drag it in flight with a disc.
I place it before your feet.
I'll watch over this.
I hold it in one grip.
I slot it into my side.
No use. Dropped.
You touched the seam I keep.
All three discs spin up.
I rise to my highest point.
I patrol this island.
Once you're off the seam, I reel my discs in.
I aim the outer disc at you.
My gears have locked in.
I've stored your position.
Three blocks tall, flying and aiming.
I begin to descend on you.
I come down from three blocks up.
Did you hear it? The disc is spinning.

lines.zh: 我压着高度，在你头顶转。
lines.en: Low and steady, I circle overhead.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，我的盘就跟到哪。
lines.en: Wherever you go, my discs follow.
I'm computing the descent angle.
This island offers no cover.
I tilt slowly toward you.
You look up, and my discs spin.
I needn't land, and I don't tire.
One more block from you will do.
I draw the outer disc tighter.
You won't finish counting to two.
I shift position.
The wind comes from behind you.

lines.zh: 我抛出一张盘，它绕着回来。
lines.en: I throw a disc and it loops back.
That cuts into your pauldron.
I drop my whole body down.
You retreat, and the disc still follows.
I drive into your pauldron.

lines.zh: 石屑从我们之间飞起来。
lines.en: Stone chips fly between us.
The second disc is away.
You blocked the first.
I rise back up and re-align.
My discs whine higher.
Still standing. Impressive.

lines.zh: 这一片地面被我切开了。
lines.en: I've cut open the ground here.
A whirring starts high above.
I descend from above the island.

lines.zh: 整片林子忽然暗了一下。
lines.en: The whole forest dims for a moment.
My shell's edges show first.

lines.zh: 这里多了一个很高的影子。
lines.en: A tall shadow joins this place.

lines.zh: 我从末地岛的背面升上来。
lines.en: I rise from behind an end island.
My gears mesh layer by layer.
I hover three blocks above my anchor.
I spread all my discs.

lines.zh: 我在最高的树上方停住。
lines.en: I stop above the tallest tree.
The wind has changed. I'm here.

lines.zh: 我扫了一圈，没有别的东西。
lines.en: I scan once. Nothing else here.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的外壳，噼啪响。
lines.en: Fire crackles against my shell.

lines.zh: 我不该摔的，可我还是坠了。
lines.en: I shouldn't fall, yet I fell.

lines.zh: 水灌进壳里，我的盘停了。
lines.en: Water fills my shell and my discs stop.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀得翻了一圈。
lines.en: The blast rolls me over.

lines.zh: 一枚东西打穿了我的最外圈。
lines.en: Something pierces my outer disc.

lines.zh: 法术让我的旋转全停了。
lines.en: That spell kills all my spin.
Not enough power to stay up.

lines.zh: 雷打在我的盘阵上，火花四溅。
lines.en: Lightning hits my disc array and sparks fly.
The void pulls at me from below.
